verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI explicitly documents 'High Performance: Parallel crawling' and ships a Dockerized FastAPI server with a real-time monitoring dashboard exposing 'browser pool visibility', plus multi-URL batch configs, automatic retries/proxy chains, and resume_state/on_state_change for crash recovery on long-running crawls — all directly supporting concurrent, at-scale scraping sessions. However, community feedback (comm-2, comm-3) notes that production-grade concurrency at scale still requires the user to build the 'policy layer' (rate limiting, bot mitigation, session handling), indicating some scaling groundwork isn't fully turnkey. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks or hands-on verification of concurrency limits/throughput at scale, and first-party guidance on safely running many simultaneous sessions.
